title: Workplace stress check
intro: Eight questions to help you reflect on how work has been affecting you recently. This is not a validated clinical instrument. Your answers are not stored and are never shared with your employer.

instrument.name: NestSelf Workplace Stress Check (not a validated clinical instrument)
instrument.licence: NestSelf-authored instrument. The source URL is background reading on workplace stress from WHO, not a licence reference.

questions.text: I find it hard to switch off from work at the end of the day
I feel overwhelmed by the amount of work I need to do
I have difficulty concentrating on tasks at work
I feel tense or anxious about work-related matters
I have trouble sleeping because of work concerns
I feel I lack control over my work situation
I avoid certain tasks or responsibilities at work
I feel less motivated or engaged at work than I used to

bands.title: Low workplace stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a low level of workplace stress. Keeping your current balance is a great foundation.
bands.nextStep: Explore our wellbeing articles for ideas on maintaining balance at work.

bands.title: Moderate workplace stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a moderate level of workplace stress. Small adjustments or talking things through with someone could help.
bands.nextStep: Consider using our conversation planner to prepare a talk with your manager, or speak with a psychologist through your employer's programme.

bands.title: High workplace stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a high level of workplace stress. Professional support is available and can help you find practical ways forward.
bands.nextStep: We recommend booking a confidential session with a psychologist through your employer's programme. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

bands.title: Very high workplace stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a very high level of workplace stress. Please consider reaching out for support soon.
bands.nextStep: Book a confidential session with a psychologist through your employer's programme as soon as possible. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

disclaimer: This tool is not a medical device and does not provide a diagnosis. It is for informational purposes only. For a clinical evaluation, talk to a licensed professional. If you are in crisis, call the emergency number.

crisis.title: Need immediate help?
crisis.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now.
